issues.description: The solution's Person class declares the birthday field as String while its getter and setter use LocalDate and other code (PersonService.save) expects a LocalDate. This type mismatch between the field and its accessor/mutator (and between the solution and the template/service logic) will cause compilation errors and confuses students about the intended birthday type.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution repository, change the Person.birthday field to type java.time.LocalDate to match the getter/setter and the service logic (or alternatively change getters/setters and service to consistently use String). Also update equals/hashCode and any related code to use LocalDate consistently so the template, tests, and solution align.
